repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
wait until(all(#SmokeDetector).smokeDetector_smoke == true)
all(#Speaker).speaker_speak("Smoke detected.")
all(#EmailProvider).emailProvider_sendMail("test@example.com", "Fire Warning", "A fire has occurred. Please evacuate.")

diagnosis.summary: The candidate uses a periodic `if (phase == 0)` structure which only evaluates the guard at the start of each 5-minute iteration. The IR requires the `EmailProvider` to send an email immediately after the initial `Speaker` call (at t=0), not one period later. The candidate fails to emit the required action at the same instant as the IR because the `else` branch is not reached until the next cycle start.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the `phase` state machine and the `else` branch. Merged the initial pre-cycle actions (wait, speak, send) into a single block that executes once at the start. The `period` remains 300000 to satisfy the IR's infinite cycle requirement, but the body now correctly emits the email immediately after the smoke detection wait completes, matching the IR's sequence.
